_meta.title: SDR to HDR
_meta.description: Core ImageSDRToHDR (Lottes-style inverse tone map) expands an SDR sRGB image to HLG-encoded Rec.2020 (BT.2100) with a peak-white target in nits (0 = calibrated rendering). Saves two files with core SaveImageAdvanced: a 10-bit HLG AVIF (CJ_HDR/hdr_NNNNN_.avif) that is the job image and shows as HDR on HDR displays (browsers tone-map it on SDR screens), and a scene-linear Rec.2020 OpenEXR master (adrift_master/, half or full float) listed as a download. This is an expansion curve, not recovered highlights: clipped areas stay clipped. No models.
